artist.name: Nida
artist.bio: Nida Merchant is a Mumbai-born DJ who plays disco, house, acid house and Afro-influenced music. She founded the ParaDisco party series, which has run in Delhi, Goa, London and Mumbai, and co-founded New Delhi Community Radio, where she is a resident. She has played Boiler Room and Mixmag Lab and also runs the fashion label Kefi by Nida.

eras.sound: Disco and house with acid house and Afro beats
